messages:
tess (support): FYI customer Acme Corp (org_id=org_9876) reports voucher applied in UI (green check) but free-trial credits not showing in balance or usage. They attached screenshot and partner_tx_id=ptx_20260317_42.
liam (billing-eng): Can you paste the full webhook payload or partner delivery headers? Need partner_tx_id + grant_id if present.
tess (support): Partner sent this webhook to /webhooks/partner-redeem, delivery 200 OK from our gateway. Payload they forwarded (redacted):
```json
{
  "partner_tx_id": "ptx_20260317_42",
  "voucher": "WEB-TRIAL-2026",
  "customer_org": "Acme Corp",
  "value": 1000,
  "currency": "credits",
  "granted_at": "2026-03-17T12:34:56Z"
}
```
Headers they showed: `X-Partner-ID: webflow-partner`, `Idempotency-Key: abc-123-ptx42`.
promo-webhook-bot: delivery log -> 2026-03-17T12:34:56Z POST /webhooks/partner-redeem 200 OK idempotency=abc-123-ptx42 gateway_request_id=greq_5512
liam (billing-eng): Thanks. I queried ledger by external_id = ptx_20260317_42 and voucher code, no entries returned. That smells like the ingest worker accepted the webhook at gateway level but the grant processor failed before persisting. Can you grab the ingest-worker logs around 12:34:56 UTC? Look for exceptions or missing keys.
tess (support): grabbing logs now — customer also pasted the UI transaction id txn_ui_7788.
(30s later) tess (support): ingest-worker log excerpt: `ERROR grant_processor.py:142 KeyError: 'account_id' while processing external_id=ptx_20260317_42`
julian (sre): KeyError on account_id suggests payload field mismatch — partner uses `customer_org` not `account_id`. We recently tightened schema validation in grant-processor v3.2 which now rejects mappings without an explicit account_id. The gateway returned 200 but the processor bubbled an exception and dropped the job.
liam (billing-eng): That matches: partner payload uses `customer_org`. Two things: (1) we need a compensating ledger entry for Acme Corp while we patch mapping logic, (2) add a safe fallback in grant-processor to map `customer_org` -> lookup account_id via org mapping table for partner webhooks.
tess (support): I'll request manual crediting. Can you provide the exact ledger write command so ops can run it? Customer expects credits today.
julian (sre): Use the payments admin job, not direct SQL. Command (run from infra tools account):
```bash
./payments-admin grant-ledger-entry \
  --account-id acct_54321 \
  --amount 1000 \
  --currency credits \
  --external-id ptx_20260317_42 \
  --provenance "partner-voucher:webflow:WEB-TRIAL-2026" \
  --notes "Manual compensating credit for failed ingest (KeyError account_id)"
```
liam (billing-eng): After writing, run `SELECT * FROM ledger_events WHERE external_id='ptx_20260317_42' LIMIT 1;` to verify. Also add a backfilled mapping row: `INSERT INTO partner_org_map (partner_id, partner_org, account_id) VALUES ('webflow-partner','Acme Corp','acct_54321');` so future webhooks map cleanly.
tess (support): Filed a support escalation (#ESCL-6123) with payments + integrations. Informed Acme; they're okay with manual credit if we confirm. I'll update when ops confirms the ledger event. :thumbsup:
liam (billing-eng): I'll open a PR to add the `customer_org` fallback in grant-processor and add a small metric to count dropped webhooks for partner=webflow-partner.
julian (sre): Also recommend we change gateway success response to only return 200 after enqueue to grant-processor completes to avoid false-positive acks. Created ticket SRE-2981.
tess (support): Ops confirmed ledger write at 2026-03-17T12:48:20Z, entry created, account acct_54321 credited 1000 credits. Customer notified and confirmed balance updated. I'll close the escalation after follow-up with partner to standardize payload.
liam (billing-eng): Thanks — keep the partner sync note on PR. We'll do a short retro with integrations to avoid similar mapping gaps.
(THREAD END)
